title: Node-side recovery-window inventory adapters
description: Objective: provide complete production enumeration/negative-proof inputs for external state that can survive beyond backup cursor N on the host. Deliverable: @moe/runner recovery-inventory adapters for project-tagged provider runs/process registrations/launch locks, workspaces, Git branches/refs, integration targets represented on disk, artifact objects/staging, and their configured recovery-window coverage. The adapters must reuse the shipped Codex/Claude probe capabilities, launch-lock records, hermetic Git observer, workspace manifests, and artifact store rather than inventing a fixture authority. MEASURED GAP at HEAD 1ce0059: those per-area observation primitives exist, but no production module enumerates them as one cursor/incarnation-bound inventory; `rg` finds no orphan inventory or recovery coverage protocol. NOT in scope: scheduler resource rows, deciding adopt/quarantine, clearing a project embargo, R3 approval, ordinary restart classification, or tests/fault. Hard dependencies: task-5606947a9d7d4f228dc63e6ce4dea69a supplies cursor/generation identity and task-684e6972c8c1418f8996ea3edd61f00c supplies the recovery-incarnation binding. Owned paths: packages/runner/src/recovery-inventory/** and focused @moe/runner exports only. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test.
definitionOfDone: The production inventory API accepts an exact project, backup cursor/generation, recovery incarnation, recovery-window bounds, and frozen configured class set; it returns canonical items and one explicit COMPLETE or UNKNOWN coverage proof per configured node-side class.

Provider/process/lock, workspace, Git/integration-on-disk, and artifact/staging adapters call the existing production probes/observers/stores and bind every item to class, stable external identity, observed disposition facts, and source proof digest without treating silence as absence.

An unavailable enumerator, unsupported provider capability, truncated/over-limit result, malformed project tag, or missing negative proof returns stable `RECOVERY_INVENTORY_COVERAGE_UNKNOWN` at layer `INVENTORY_ADAPTER`, truth `UNKNOWN`; partial items cannot upgrade coverage.

Enumeration order and digest are deterministic across path separators and locale on Windows, macOS, and Linux; duplicate external identities or entries outside the exact project/window refuse rather than merge.

Focused tests exercise real temporary filesystem/Git/artifact bytes plus shipped provider-probe surfaces, assert every configured class generated at least one coverage case, pin exact code/layer, and mutation-check production coverage handling.
taskRails: Authoritative design is D:/projexts/moes/docs/plans/2026-08-05-moe-rebuild-design.md SHA-256 1D9D1EC97D3F07247FBBC088045E0BA2FD6DA8307F10A9026C55106419383191; do not edit it.
A configured class requires complete enumeration or a verifiable negative proof; an empty list, quiet process, absent optional probe, or mock response is never COMPLETE by itself.
This pure/adapter package must name and be consumed by the daemon coordinator task before completion; root exports alone are not composition.
Tests assert exact stable reason code and `INVENTORY_ADAPTER` layer and assert non-zero generated class coverage.
Target <=250 physical lines per production source and split before 400; this cap is per file.
